profile_text.body:
The material provided for CCC Intelligent Solutions Holdings Inc. is thin and internally inconsistent. The company's own website text describes Calgon Carbon as an activated carbon company focused on air and water purification, citing its FILTRASORB product, a reagglomerated, coal-based activated carbon that the site says has over 40 years of use in TOC reduction and contaminant removal for drinking water, wastewater treatment, and purification in process water, food, pharmaceutical, and industrial applications. The site says FILTRASORB is made in the United States. No AI products or AI positioning appear in the harvested site text.

The held facts record the company as a public company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, with ticker CCC and SEC CIK 0001818201, matched as an EDGAR registrant. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are listed for it. The only litigation-related field is a law exposure count of 376 for Illinois, which is a state-level figure rather than a case list.

The website field points to calgoncarbon.com, which does not match the company name, so the site text and the corporate identity in the held facts may not describe the same entity. Nothing in the data connects the company to AI products or services.
